build_memory_writer: build a MemoryWriter Sonnet RNNCore that writes values into a memory matrix using round-robin indexing
build_memory_reader: build a MemoryReader Sonnet module that performs content-based cosine similarity reads from memory with multiple read heads
run_read_from_memory: run the read_from_memory function to perform cosine similarity content-based lookup with optional top-k filtering
create_read_information: create a ReadInformation namedtuple to hold read weights, indices, keys, and strengths from memory reads
review_memory_reader_build: review the MemoryReader _build method that generates read keys and strengths via a linear layer and reads memory
